#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: Oh yeah! There was this one guy who streamed ‘playing’ with one of those. It was pretty funny to read about it on the news.
You: I-I’m sure it was, hehe…
Oh God.
If she will somehow deduce that it was me streaming I will burn with shame forever… 
Me being a weirdo was supposed to be a secret, never discovered by society. 
'Nun' Shanice: I don’t know why, but this room looks kinda familiar…
Goodbye, last remnants of my social life…
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: It’s my first time being here so there’s no way I know this place, right?
You: Y-yeah, no way.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: You alright? 
I need to act calmer. Keep it together man!
